notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.effective_date: taxable years of foreign corporations beginning after Dec.
notes.text: Repeal applicable to taxable years of foreign corporations beginning after Dec. 31, 2017, and to taxable years of United States shareholders in which or with which such taxable years of foreign corporations end, see section 14301(d) of Pub. L. 115–97, set out as an Effective Date of 2017 Amendment note under section 78 of this title.
